subject: Original-client W3 ranged gate acquisition from copied accepted-1995 checkpoint
setup: Restored compatibility client 1.16.5.0 with disposable deployed-derived Auth/Game and copied character, normal seeded hostile stats. Mission 1995 was already accepted; no same-session Youngblood handoff is claimed. The live Game/DIT service was untouched.

sources.finding: Original compatibility client tooltip displays 60 m optimal range for the recruit rifle. This does not establish the server's actual maximum shot range.

observations.finding: After three seconds of ordinary movement the client /loc showed (73.9,109.0,139.2). The Thrax was visible on the gate approach. By frame aim-4 the client displayed a top target panel naming 'Thrax Infantry Initiate', even though the local close-range nameplate crop was negative. The controller stopped without Tab/fire because it inspected only that local crop.

The next three-second walk landed at (79.7,109.0,144.6), a different heading/position from the preceding attempt. The moving Thrax appeared far left of the reticle and the bounded horizontal sweep showed no target panel or local label. It stopped before Tab/fire. No enemy, weapon, or mission data changed.

At range the target panel appears around screenshot x410–595,y58–105, outside the controller's local nameplate crop x500–750,y335–445. Offline OCR of crop 240x70+400+50 reads 'Thrax Infantry Initiate' on aim-4 and stays empty on aim-0.

observations.source_location: s5-gate-fire-sweep-w3-1/drive-s5-gate-fire-sweep-w3.log; output/game.log lines 141 and 149; output/02-gate-after-sweep.png; manifest copied_state_after_stop
observations.finding: A third W3 attempt reached (73.9,109.0,139.2). Holding ordinary primary fire while sweeping the camera in short turns caused the original client to send SetTargetId; the gate Thrax died and the copied character gained 71 XP and 10 credits. After two seconds' further movement and the existing post-gate route, /loc displayed (0.8,99.5,128.7) at the fence. The controller stopped just outside its old x<=0 branch guard before soldier or corpse interaction. The copied databases were restored.

assessment: Ordinary auto-fire and short camera turns can acquire and kill the moving gate Thrax from the W3 approach in the current emulator. Earlier serial aim failures were test-controller limits. This is an emulator functionality check, not proof of original final-live enemy balance. The uninterrupted route to wounded soldier and corpse remains unverified.
next_check: Continue from the measured fence waypoint after confirmed normal gate combat; inspect short movement around its original sandbags before taking a branch toward the outpost Thrax and wounded soldier. Keep final-live combat values and exact route as evidence gaps.
